info.description: This course explores how information and communication technologies (ICT) transform logistics and supply chain operations in the digital era. It equips students with analytical and technological competencies to understand, assess, and design digital logistics systems through a global and sustainable lens.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Build a solid foundation of knowledge on the principles and historical development of e-logistics, enabling them to recognise its strategic significance within modern supply chains.
Develop critical analytical skills to examine how ICT tools and systems are applied across different modes of transport and logistics hubs, thereby improving efficiency and transparency.

Enhance evaluative competencies in assessing the role of automation technologies in warehousing and order fulfilment, with a focus on their contributions to operational accuracy, speed, and cost reduction.

Cultivate investigative abilities to explore and interpret the functions of digital platforms, such as electronic logistics marketplaces and single window systems, in facilitating integration and regulatory compliance.
Foster innovative and solution-oriented thinking to propose e-logistics strategies that utilise advanced technologies to address global supply chain challenges while promoting sustainability.
